items.title: AI & Machine Learning
items.description: Analyzes soil chemistry, weather dynamics and crop health to predict harvest yield and recommend surgical agronomic actions before stress manifests.
bullets: Predictive disease & fungal outbreak vectoring 72 hours prior to visible foliar symptoms.
Dynamic micro-irrigation automated every 15 minutes matching evapotranspiration curves.
Precision harvest yield forecasting with 98.4% verified historical accuracy.

items.title: Autonomous Robotics
items.description: Solar-powered robots for planting, mechanical weeding and harvesting, working 24/7 without diesel emissions under extreme desert heat.
bullets: Zero-emission solar drive with autonomous inductive charging stations for 24/7 continuity.
Non-chemical precision laser & mechanical weeding, eliminating synthetic herbicide dependence.
Tender-touch robotic arm end-effectors calibrated for fragile fruit and date harvesting.

items.title: Advanced Drone Fleet
items.description: Multi-spectral sensors that map thousands of hectares and detect moisture stress, nutrient deficiency and pests early.
bullets: 6-band multispectral radiometric sensors resolving ground detail down to 1.2 cm per pixel.
Weatherproof autonomous launch hives capable of operating in 48°C ambient conditions.
Cloud orthomosaic synthesis generating NDVI vegetation heatmaps within 30 minutes.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers on deploying AGverse technology across your fields.

items.q: What is included in the complimentary Tech Audit?
items.a: Our agronomy and drone engineering team analyzes your soil salinity, historical water expenditures, satellite imagery, and crop varieties to deliver a custom ROI breakdown and autonomy roadmap within 5 business days.

items.q: How does AGverse hardware endure severe summer heat (50°C+)?
items.a: All AGverse field robots and drone docking hives are engineered to IP67 standards with active liquid thermal regulation and sand-deflecting dust seals tested specifically in UAE desert conditions.

items.q: Can AGverse integrate with our existing tractors and irrigation pumps?
items.a: Yes. Our universal IoT controller retrofits onto existing drip manifolds, pivot systems, and diesel tractors, immediately bridging legacy hardware to our AI brain.

items.q: What is the minimum farm size for deployment?
items.a: While our system scales to thousands of hectares, our starter clusters are optimized for farms starting from 10 hectares (or 2.5 hectares for high-density greenhouses).

items.q: ما الذي يتضمنه التدقيق التقني المجاني؟
items.a: يقوم مهندسونا الزراعيون بفحص ملوحة التربة، ونفقات الري التاريخية، وصور الأقمار الصناعية لتقديم خطة أتمتة مخصصة وعائد استثماري مفصل خلال 5 أيام عمل.

items.q: كيف تتحمل معدات إيه جي فيرس حرارة الصيف الشديدة (أكثر من 50 درجة مئوية)؟
items.a: صُممت جميع روبوتات الحقل وخلايا الطائرات وفق معايير IP67 مع تبريد سائل نشط وعوازل للرمال مخصصة لبيئة صحراء الخليج العربي.

items.q: هل يمكن ربط المنظومة مع الجرارات ومضخات الري الحالية؟
items.a: نعم بالتأكيد، يتم تركيب وحدات التحكم الذكية (IoT) الخاصة بنا على شبكات الري الحالية والجرارات لتوصيلها مباشرة بمركز الذكاء الاصطناعي.

items.q: ما هو الحد الأدنى لمساحة المزرعة المؤهلة؟
items.a: تخدم المنظومة مساحات واسعة تصل لآلاف الهكتارات، وتبدأ حزم التدشين الأولية من 10 هكتارات (أو 2.5 هكتار للبيوت المحمية عالية الكثافة).

privacy.title: Privacy & Data Protection Policy
privacy.body:
1. Compliance Framework: AGverse adheres strictly to UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 regarding Personal Data Protection (PDPL) as well as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

2. Agricultural Telemetry: All soil composition data, drone multispectral orthomosaics, and irrigation consumption metrics captured from client farms remain the exclusive property of the landowner.

3. Information We Collect: We collect contact details provided via our audit request forms, technical inquiries, and automated IoT sensor heartbeats.

4. Security & Encryption: All data transmitted between field rovers, docking hives, and the AGverse cloud engine is secured using AES-256 encryption.

5. Inquiries: For inquiries regarding your farm data or erasure requests, contact privacy@agverse.ae.

terms.title: Terms of Service & Farm SLA
terms.body:
1. Scope of Service: AGverse provides autonomous agricultural telemetry, robotic weed management, and predictive yield analytics.

2. Airspace & UAE GCAA Compliance: All drone scout operations are performed in full accordance with UAE General Civil Aviation Authority (GCAA) regulations and licensed local airspace parameters.

3. Hardware Reliability & SLAs: AGverse guarantees a 99.4% uptime for deployed field hives and automated subsurface irrigation controllers.

4. Intellectual Property: The AGverse neural agronomy models, hardware end-effectors, and platform interfaces are proprietary trade secrets of AGverse Ltd. (Dubai, UAE).
